title: Chapter 927
paragraphs: Chapter 927
Episode 230. Invasion and Raid (8)
Whirr…!
The rune letters inscribed on Jin's body by Sara shone, and a red flame surged.
The authority of gravity could not be added, but the fiercely flaring flame quickly burned away the magic energy rushing towards Jin.
Even if the authority was blocked, Jin is Jin, and fire is fire.
The Fire of Yeomje, which Jin inherited, was shining more than ever.
Along with the flame, Jin, hiding a flash gun in his left hand, charged towards the approaching Paelleto.
Even if he ended up being pushed back, he had to rush in first.
Only by taking a bit of control could he create variables.
Only then could he prolong his survival time.
He had to restart the fight, trusting his body's memory and response.
The blade, wrapped in flames, sliced through the purple magic energy.
Paelleto struck Bradamante down, and before his sword hit the ground, Jin rotated his body and continued his attack.
Vertical and horizontal, the two swords crossed in an X, and a loud noise erupted.
In an instant, Jin didn't miss the smell of blood coming from Paelleto.
'The smell of blood... Did he also get injured when he spread that massive sword energy that broke Ayura's protective shield? Probably a slight backlash.'
It was a strong smell of blood unique to the demons, not humans, and it was clear that the blood had just spilled.
The only demon fighting in the Bellium Plains was Paelleto, so it was his blood.
That internal injury did not dull Paelleto's sword. It was just a small scratch on the iron fortress.
However, for Jin, this fact came as hope.

'There could be several reasons for the backlash. Using great power in a strained state with reduced abilities due to brainwashing, the inner turmoil engulfed by hatred due to Sakiel's death, and... demonization.'
Demonization.
The fate of those who have ascended to Changseong.
There was a high possibility that Paelleto's backlash and internal injury were the aftermath of demonization.
What accelerates demonization is 'emotion'.
Hatred, fear, attachment, obsession… all these emotions could turn a person who has ascended to Changseong into a monster at any time.
'Paelleto is... falling into the heart of the devil…!'
As soon as such conviction arose, Jin thought.
The only way for Paelleto to die now is for him to succumb to the heart of the devil and destroy himself.
It means to hold out with his companions until Paelleto self-destructs.
"Jin!"
Finally, Dante and Hedo penetrated Paelleto's magic and arrived back at the center of the battlefield.
Four swords mingled incessantly, causing flashes.
However, all the blood droplets oxidizing in the air were red.
Their swords could not touch Paelleto, while Bascara repeatedly cut them and passed by.
Persistent.
Those who killed Sakiel are still persistently swinging their swords.
This fact was disturbing Paelleto's inner self.
"In the past, how many have saved you from a crisis?"
"Countless."
"You must be hoping it will be the same this time."
Whooa……!
Jin fired the flash gun and stabbed Paelleto's waist.
'Crap!'
Surely, he thought he had fired the flash gun. However, the moment Jin reached out, Paelleto was already clutching his left fist.
Crack-!
The left hand holding the flash gun collapsed altogether.
If Jin had flinched and tried to pull out at that moment, his arm would have been torn off.
Instead of pulling back, Jin clung even closer to Paelleto and stabbed Bradamante into his neck.
Paelleto let go of Jin's arm and stepped back. Bradamante grazed Paelleto's cheek.
At the same time, Dante and Hedo left cuts on his thigh and side respectively, but these were too shallow to compensate for Jin's shattered left hand.
The magic power of the flash gun flowed out between the twisted fingers.
Without even checking its status with his eyes, Jin summoned new magic power in his left hand.

In the end, when he had to hold the sword with both hands, all he needed to do was create an ice barrier and forcibly fix it on the handle, and when he had to use magic like now, he didn't need grip strength.
Of course, it's not that there was no damage at all, but it was fortunate that the best choice Paelleto made at that moment was limited to the left hand.
If it was just a bit closer, it would have been the heart.
"But not today. You will surely die by my hand. Like just now, slowly tormenting your body one by one... and finally, piercing your heart."
Sword Magic Art Number Five
Heaven Destroyer Slash, Second Style
Their eyes widened.
Just like before, Paelleto hunched down and exploded with power.
He seemed momentarily defenseless, but his magic stretched out like a blade in all directions, forcing the group to back off.
However, this time, the Heaven Destroyer Slash wasn't aimed at the sky.
The group expected Paelleto to unleash the Heaven Destroyer Slash towards the front, where Jin was standing. His posture suggested so.
When releasing a massive amount of power at once to form the Heaven Destroyer Slash, even a little deviation would make it hard to change the predetermined path.
Especially in the current state of Paelleto, where the heart of the devil is in progress.
"Ji-in!"
Dante and Hedo quickly fired their sword energy.
Their intention was to somehow cause a shock, to at least make the trajectory of the Heaven Destroyer Slash deviate.
But the next moment, Jin realized.
"It's not aiming for me...! No!"
Paelleto had just used a small trick.
He took a posture towards Jin, but from the beginning, he didn't aim for Jin.
The Heaven Destroyer Slash was aimed at Hedo.
Swoosh… beep…!
Paelleto's energy exploded, lifting Jin and the group into the air.
The ringing in their ears that felt like their heads were being torn apart was oppressive, and within the layers of exploding shockwaves, the group was scattered in an instant.
Hedo, watch out! Hedo, watch out...!
Shouting didn't make any sound.
It felt like their throats were blocked with water, and their vision went dark.
Their bodies felt like they were melting into a swamp.
In this way, Jin and his companions once again lost consciousness for a moment.
When they regained consciousness, the first scene Jin and Dante faced was the trajectory of the Heaven Destroyer Slash, stretching endlessly like the horizon.
If the Heaven Destroyer Slash First Style tore the sky with two sword strikes, the Second Style split the Belium Plains in half with a single strike.
Not only the plains but also all objects, terrain, and life that were in a straight line behind it, were split in half.
The grotesquely split land no longer looked like a plain.
It had transformed into an endlessly torn, sharply diagonal abyss.
In the gap, the magic and lava that the Heaven Destroyer Slash carried were erupting and mixing.
They spouted up to the sky and scattered in all directions, and the lands weakened by the Heaven Destroyer Slash could not bear even their weight and crumbled in despair.
And nowhere in that dreadful landscape was Hedo's figure visible.
There were no traces at all.
No voice could be heard, and his unique powerful energy could not be felt at all.
They could only think that the Heaven Destroyer Slash swallowed him.
"It seems you all didn't listen to my words properly. I said clearly that I would reap the heart at the end. Disappearing like dust is too easy."
They had to pull themselves together.
The two of them erased the anxiety welling up in their hearts and pointed their swords at Paelleto.
"Oh, are you thinking that he didn't die because you didn't see the main sword yourself? If so, keep denying it. That's not a bad thing for me either."
Paelleto said with a smile.
He did not show any backflow reaction unlike right after using the Heaven Destroyer Slash for the first time.
Whether he forcibly hid it, or there was really nothing, Jin and Dante couldn't tell.
"Deciding how to kill you makes me feel a lot better, Jin Runkandel."
Jin was stirring up his inner fire again.
He decided that he couldn't continue a proper offense and defense without strengthening his body with the inner fire.
However, the accumulated shock so far was the problem.
Jin is not immortal.
He is not invincible, and he is not stronger than Paelleto. As his power of spiritual energy and brain energy were completely blocked, the gap was only widening.
Naturally, there were side effects of continuously maintaining strength to the limit against a clearly stronger character. His magical power started showing signs of backflow.
Blood was rushing from his mouth and nose.
The power of the inner fire was maintained as same as before, but it wouldn't be strange if the release of magical power suddenly broke at any moment.
Dante stood next to Jin.
Now, there was no point in Dante disrupting Paelleto's rear.
Somehow, they had to stick together and endure the battle.
"Jin, I can't tell you to leave as I buy us some time. As you know, it's now impossible. We're both pretty badly wounded already."
"Also, I wouldn't want that either. If I wanted to prepare that much for death, I wouldn't have sent Murakan in the first place."
Fight and tenacity.
Those were the only things the two didn't fall short on compared to Paelleto.
Suddenly, Dante felt a strange, transcendent energy pouring out from Jin's sweat-soaked face.
Just like the day his grandfather reached Changseong.
In reality, Jin didn't possess such energy right now.
However, in the past, giants of the era such as Shirone, Ron, Talalis, and Kelliac had confirmed the same potential from Luna, and later from Jin when he began to make a name for himself.
Luna Runkandel, Jin Runkandel is a person who has the potential to win against anyone in the world, no matter how strong they are.
That's what Dante faintly felt. Although he couldn't perceive it as clearly as they did.
"Dante, it's to the left. Hedo Gyeong is not dead."
Jin thought Dante momentarily lost focus because of Hedo Gyeong.
Dante nodded his head and blocked Paelleto's sword energy that was flying in from the right.
"I believe so too. However, it was to the right."
"I was just checking if you were okay. You were uncharacteristically zoning out."
No matter where they looked, all they could see was magic and lava. The two of them backed up against each other and gauged the direction Paelleto was charging from.
They couldn't block all the magic that was pouring in like poison.
If they swung their swords to push away the magic, Paelleto would directly attack at that moment, so they had to block it only with the shield.
'...... Suddenly, the flow of magic started to change, forming a magic circle.'
Jin recognized that fact immediately.
"Get out of the shield!"
The moment Jin shouted, the magic instantly covered the shield of the two with a magic circle.
The form of the magic circle that they briefly confirmed was of the dark realm.
Among them, runes meaning 'curse' were emitting a deep purple light.
The two of them got out of the shield before the curse fully formed, but at the last moment, each of their left shoulders and right ankles were caught in the wave of the curse.
The name of the curse was 'Mockery of Bisaro'. The effect was forced aging of the target.
Jin was feeling the sensation of the curse gnawing at his body for the first time since his regression.
